name: email
title: Email
description: Send React Email templates through Resend. In development, mail lands in a local outbox at /dev/outbox.

env.name: RESEND_API_KEY
env.description: Resend API key. Without it (in development) emails are saved to the local outbox

env.name: EMAIL_FROM
env.description: Default sender, on a domain verified in Resend

env.name: EMAIL_OUTBOX
env.description: Set to 1 to capture every email in the outbox instead of sending (previews, staging, CI). /dev/outbox then works in production builds too

postInstall: In development, open /dev/outbox to read every email the site sends.
For production, verify your domain in Resend and set RESEND_API_KEY + EMAIL_FROM.
Email colors live in src/emails/theme.ts (email clients can't read CSS variables).
